Cosmetic Dentistry

Teeth Whitening

Our professional Philips Zoom in-clinic whitening delivers dramatic, long-lasting results in just 60 minutes. Unlike over-the-counter strips, our treatment is tailored to your enamel sensitivity — brightening your smile by up to 8 shades safely.

We also offer take-home whitening kits with custom-fitted trays for gradual, gentle whitening at your own pace — ideal for sensitive teeth or top-up maintenance.

60 min In-chair session
8 shades Average result
2–3 yrs Longevity
  • Philips Zoom professional-grade whitening gel
  • Safe for enamel — supervised by our cosmetic specialist
  • Immediate, visible results in a single visit
  • Custom take-home maintenance kit included
  • Suitable for wedding, event, or occasion prep

Restorative Dentistry

Dental Implants

Dental implants are the most natural-looking, natural-feeling solution for missing teeth. A titanium post is placed directly in the jawbone, where it fuses with bone over time — creating a permanent anchor for a porcelain crown that is indistinguishable from your natural teeth.

Dr. Arjun Mehta, our chief implantologist, has placed over 3,000 implants with a documented 98.7% five-year survival rate — one of the highest in the region.

1 day Surgical session
98.7% 5-year success rate
Lifetime With care
  • Straumann & Nobel Biocare implant systems used
  • 3D CBCT planning for precise, safe placement
  • Bone grafting available if required
  • Same-day provisional crowns in most cases
  • 5-year implant warranty included

Orthodontics

Braces & Clear Aligners

Crooked or misaligned teeth affect not just aesthetics but also bite function and oral hygiene. Our orthodontic specialist, Dr. Rohit Bhatia, offers a full range of solutions — from near-invisible clear aligners to precision metal and ceramic braces.

Treatment plans typically range from 6 to 24 months depending on the complexity, and we use digital simulation to show you the projected outcome before a single bracket is placed.

6–24 mo Treatment duration
3 types Metal / Ceramic / Clear
Digital Outcome preview
  • Invisalign-style clear aligners — removable and discreet
  • Ceramic brackets — tooth-coloured for discretion
  • Traditional metal braces for complex cases
  • Lingual braces fitted behind the teeth
  • Retainer included post-treatment

Cosmetic Dentistry

Porcelain Veneers

Veneers are ultra-thin porcelain shells — roughly the thickness of a contact lens — bonded to the front surface of your teeth to instantly transform their shape, colour, and alignment. They are the secret behind many celebrity smiles.

Dr. Priya Sharma uses a digital smile design process, photographing and mapping your face so your veneers are perfectly proportioned to your features. The result looks entirely natural.

2 visits Typical treatment
0.5 mm Ultra-thin shell
15 yrs Average lifespan
  • IPS e.max pressed porcelain — strongest available
  • Digital smile design mock-up before commitment
  • Minimal tooth reduction — enamel-safe technique
  • Stain-resistant and colour-stable for years
  • Fixes chips, gaps, discolouration, and shape issues simultaneously
Book Veneer Consultation
Endodontics

Root Canal Treatment

Modern root canal treatment bears no resemblance to the procedure's fearsome reputation. Under local anaesthesia and with our rotary endodontic system, most patients report feeling little more than the initial numbing injection — and leave pain-free within an hour.

Root canal therapy saves a severely infected or damaged tooth from extraction, allowing it to function normally for decades with a crown placed afterwards.

60–90 min Per session
1–2 visits Typically
Painless With local anaesthesia
  • Rotary endodontics for faster, gentler treatment
  • Electronic apex locator for pinpoint accuracy
  • Dental microscope used for complex cases
  • Eliminates infection and prevents spread
  • Tooth saved and fully functional after crown placement
Book Root Canal Appointment
Advanced Dentistry

Laser Dentistry

SmileCare uses the Fotona Lightwalker dental laser — one of the most advanced dental laser systems in the world. Laser dentistry replaces traditional drills for many procedures, resulting in less discomfort, minimal bleeding, faster healing, and in many cases no need for local anaesthesia.

Applications include gum reshaping, cavity removal, gum disease treatment, frenectomy, and cosmetic gum contouring for a more symmetrical, attractive smile line.

Minimal Pain & bleeding
Faster Healing time
Precise Tissue accuracy
  • Gum contouring for a balanced, aesthetic smile line
  • Laser cavity removal — often without anaesthesia
  • Laser periodontal (gum disease) therapy
  • Frenectomy for tongue-tie and lip-tie
  • Laser teeth whitening activation

Children's Dentistry

Paediatric Dental Care

A child's first dental experience shapes their attitude toward oral health for life. Our paediatric wing is designed from the ground up to be child-friendly — bright colours, friendly decor, and a team trained in behaviour management techniques that help even the most anxious children feel safe and confident.

Dr. Kavita Nair, our specialist paediatric dentist, sees children from infancy through to their teenage years, providing preventive care, early orthodontic assessment, and restorative treatment.

6 months Recommended first visit age
Specialist MDS Pedodontics
Fun Child-first approach
  • First visit from 6 months — habit and development guidance for parents
  • Fluoride varnish and pit-and-fissure sealants
  • Painless treatment with happy gas (nitrous oxide) option
  • Early orthodontic intervention assessments
  • Space maintainers for premature primary tooth loss

Foundation of Oral Health

Preventive Dental Care

The most effective — and most affordable — dental care is the kind that prevents problems from ever developing. Our preventive programme includes twice-yearly comprehensive check-ups, professional ultrasonic scaling and polishing, oral cancer screening, and personalised oral hygiene instruction.

We'll identify early signs of decay, gum disease, grinding, or bite issues before they become expensive problems — and provide a written treatment plan with honest timelines and costs.

2× per yr Recommended check-ups
Oral Cancer Screening included
Customised Hygiene plan
  • Full-mouth clinical examination with digital X-rays
  • Professional ultrasonic scaling and air polishing
  • Fluoride treatment to strengthen enamel
  • Oral cancer and soft-tissue screening
  • Personalised brushing and interdental cleaning instruction
